policy: Every mounted cell is inventoried. Active annotations retain unchanged water masks within their bounds; changed annotations remain in pendingReview and are not rendered. New coastal cells use alpha-derived coverage pending inland review. Paths are visual art interpretation, not surveyed hydrology. Original land alpha is immutable; gorge and purple-brook annotations have priority.
